title: Q5.2 isolated native canonical regression qualification
goal: Qualify whether the observed canonical Criterion regressions persist under an isolated native CI runner. Preserve and report the existing local failures; never waive the 5%/3% thresholds or replace prior receipts.

out_of_scope: benchmark implementations, sizes, seeds, Criterion defaults, thresholds, comparator behavior, Cargo manifests/lockfile, runtime implementation, Q5.2 acceptance status
scope.workflow_effect: Add Ubuntu qualification job conditioned on codex/careops-q52 branch prefix. Existing aggregate depends on it and requires success for Q52; a skipped qualification job is permitted for other branches. Job waits for native+arrow-io-floor. The pinned F comparison is Q52-specific and must not become an unrelated C1 or future-track baseline.
scope.workflow_triggers: Add both new benches/queue Python paths to pull_request.paths. Existing Rust-owner path filters remain unchanged; changes to the workflow itself already trigger the workflow.

ci_design.checkout: Existing pinned checkout, fetch-depth:0, persist-credentials:false; ref github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha; EXPECTED_HEAD uses same expression. Require actual current HEAD equals EXPECTED_HEAD; record both run head and actual producer head, source clean before/after.
ci_design.toolchain: Install and verify Rust 1.99.0; assert x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu. Use the existing pinned setup-python action at Python 3.14.8; no third-party Python packages.
ci_design.baseline: Hardcode accepted F f18aba1f1930aec228e830c9e58c67e4081ac4bb; create detached baseline worktree at .artifacts/ci/q52-native-baseline after full-depth checkout; verify its HEAD exactly equals F and its tracked worktree is clean. Place F and current target/output separately beneath the current checkout’s .artifacts/ci/q52-native so the existing artifact upload preserves both.
ci_design.artifacts: Retain receipts, logs, normalized means/reports, raw Criterion output and source/binary hash maps under .artifacts/ci/q52-native via always upload. Targets remain owned local build outputs and are excluded from upload; no private lease/token files or complete source checkout uploaded.
ci_design.serialization: Single job; needs existing native and arrow-io-floor jobs. Within it, build F and current serially before any timed command, then execute only the six timed commands in the fixed interleaved sequence below. No matrix, parallel child commands, or concurrent managed compilation/timing. Use fixed explicit subdirectory per benchmark in CRITERION_HOME (criterion/<F|current>/<scheduler|state|hybrid>) so six mappings below resolve exactly. No environment timing overrides.

commands.criterion_settings: Existing Criterion source defaults, including 100 samples/default warmup and measurement; --noplot and CRITERION_HOME change output behavior/location only. Do not pass sample-size, warmup, measurement-time, feature, or seed overrides.

qualification_script_requirements: Pure Python standard library; validator must reject wrong accepted-F/current HEADs, missing or duplicate canonical IDs, missing/malformed/nonpositive Criterion mean point estimates, missing raw output, missing logs, nonzero commands, changed canonical benchmark definitions/settings/comparator/thresholds, dirty tracked source, and source drift during the run.

Capture argv, cwd, UTC start/finish, exit code, toolchain/host, current and F HEAD/status, hashes for Cargo inputs, all three benchmark sources, kairo-ecs-bench library, relevant core/state/types/rng package source files, benchmark manifest/smoke, threshold source, comparator, and each actual Running-line executable SHA256. Capture command-log SHA256 and raw Criterion estimates SHA256.

Permit and report expected source differences in benchmark dependency packages between accepted F and current; require benchmark definitions, harnesses, lock/manifests/toolchain, comparator, thresholds, smoke/manifest, seed/config inputs to match F exactly. Record both source hash maps so results stay source-bound.

Normalize exactly six Criterion mean.point_estimate values from nanoseconds/iteration to mean_seconds by division by 1e9; write baseline.json and current.json in comparator schema, retaining exact raw estimates and hashes.

Invoke unchanged benches/regression/compare.py with the frozen thresholds, baseline/current normalized files and report output. A threshold failure is a real job failure, but always preserve the complete evidence artifact; no acceptance waiver or source relabeling.

Tests use tempfile/mocked command/file inputs only; include valid six-ID result, wrong baseline/current SHA, missing/duplicate IDs, invalid means, altered threshold/harness hash, nonzero/missing command evidence, and hash/drift rejection. No compiler or Criterion execution in unit tests.

Reject boolean, NaN/infinite and nonpositive means. Verify executable paths from actual Cargo Running lines are regular files in declared target/release/deps and hash them; receipt normalization never substitutes expected timings. Preserve failure receipt for launch/build/parser/comparator errors; stop dependent commands after failure.

no_source_edit_or_ci_dispatch_until: Coordinator review of this draft and exact worktree/base SHA
Independent review of scope, baseline provenance, serialization, source hash closure, and fail-closed behavior
review_gate.implementation_verification: No native comparison is claimed until the GitHub Ubuntu job actually completes with qualified receipts and six canonical rows. Preserve original local comparisons (including later local rerun failures) as independent observations.
